newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond rally marches on.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian 10-yr bond rally marches on.

text.p: *The Australian 10-year bond futures contract struck a new contract high during a shortened SYCOM session on Friday due to the U.S. holiday and further gains cannot be ruled out.
*ANZ job advertisements due at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) and may give clue to Thursday's key labour force data.
The Australian 10-year bond futures contract struck a new contract high during a shortened SYCOM session on Friday, due to the U.S. holiday, and further gains cannot be ruled out.
The contract ended the after hours trading at 93.200, up from Friday's 93.190 pit close and after touching 93.210, the highest level for a front positon since mid-February 1994.

However, Peter Pontikis, technical strategist at Westpac Banking Corp feels that the front end of the curve needs to play catch up to the 10-year's rally before it can realistically test resistance at 93.250.
In the past week the 10-year contract put on over 30 basis points while the three-year contract added just 18 basis points.
The 10-year bond will likely keep its positive tone, however, while support from a week-old steep rising trend line at 93.140 holds, analysts said.

Fundamentally the key focus for the market this week will be Thursday's labour force data for June as a clue to future monetary policy, although today's release of the ANZ jobs advertisement series at 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT) will provide a prelude to the data.
